purpose: Settings for turnstile.py, a shared GPU queue and worker slots for one workstation. Windows are local times. RAM figures are GiB: each job runs in its own memory group capped at job_ram_gib (workers at worker_ram_gib) unless it asks for up to ram_cap_max_gib, and starts only when its cap fits in available memory beside ram_reserve_gib. A window keeps other GPU jobs from starting into it, and stays shut while any of its units (systemd user services) is running or cannot be read, so a late or long scheduled run keeps the GPU. A short run still going at its deadline with no normal slot free is asked to stop, then ended stop_grace_seconds later. The windows list starts empty; see the README for an example.
